description: This file defines the JsonValue interface, representing a JSON value in the project. It includes static factory methods for creating JSON literals, numbers, strings, and a method to infer appropriate JSON values from Java objects. It also declares methods for type inspection, casting, serialization, and size estimation related to JSON values. The interface is part of a JSON handling library within the project.

methods.name: nullLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JSON literal representing null.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a JSON value from a boolean, int, long, double, or String input. Also infers JSON value type from a generic Java object.

methods.name: isBoolean
methods.description: Checks if the JSON value is a boolean literal.

methods.name: isNumber
methods.description: Checks if the JSON value is a number.

methods.name: isInt
methods.description: Checks if the JSON value is an integer.

methods.name: isLong
methods.description: Checks if the JSON value is of type long.

methods.name: isDouble
methods.description: Checks if the JSON value is a double.

methods.name: isString
methods.description: Checks if the JSON value is a string.

methods.name: isObject
methods.description: Checks if the JSON value is an object.

methods.name: isArray
methods.description: Checks if the JSON value is an array.

methods.name: isNull
methods.description: Checks if the JSON value is null.

methods.name: asBoolean
methods.description: Returns the value as a boolean, assuming it is a boolean.

methods.name: asInt
methods.description: Returns the value as an int, assuming it is a JSON number compatible with int.

methods.name: asLong
methods.description: Returns the value as a long, assuming it is a JSON number compatible with long.

methods.name: asDouble
methods.description: Returns the value as a double, assuming it is a JSON number.

methods.name: asString
methods.description: Returns the value as a String, assuming it is a JSON string.

methods.name: asObject
methods.description: Returns the value as a JsonObject, assuming it is a JSON object.

methods.name: asArray
methods.description: Returns the value as a JsonArray, assuming it is a JSON array.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the JSON value in minimal JSON format.

methods.name: formatAsString
methods.description: Returns string representation; unquoted if it's already a JSON string.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Serializes this JSON value into the provided serialization context.

methods.name: getUpperBoundForStringSize
methods.description: Provides an upper bound estimate for serialized size in characters.
